instantiated_cells.justification: Section 13.68(1)(a)6. requires listing a lobbyist's name/address and the total paid to that lobbyist only if the total lobbying expenditures and obligations to any lobbyist exceeds $200 during the reporting period.

Section 13.64(1) requires a principal to file a registration statement when aggregate lobbying expenditures/obligations exceed $500 in a calendar year, which is the de minimis gate for entering the reporting system (including filing expense statements under § 13.68 for registered principals).

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled sections define 'lobbyist' based on receiving economic consideration and a 5-days-per-reporting-period test, but set no dollar compensation threshold for lobbyist registration/licensure.

The bundled text provides a $500 principal registration threshold (s. 13.64) and verified statement option (s. 13.621(5)), but does not set any expenditure-dollar threshold that triggers lobbyist registration/licensure.

The bundled statute sets time-based exclusions (e.g., non-lobbyist employees devoting not more than 10 hours per reporting period) but does not provide any filing/reporting de minimis threshold expressed as a percentage of time.
